campuses.title: Columbia Point Campus
campuses.text: Основной 120-акровый кампус на полуострове Columbia Point с видами на гавань Бостона. College of Management, College of Liberal Arts, School for the Environment.

paragraphs: The University of Massachusetts Boston is the only public research university in the city of Boston and the third-largest campus in the UMass system. Founded in 1964, UMass Boston occupies a 120-acre waterfront campus on Columbia Point in Dorchester, with sweeping views of Boston Harbor and the John F. Kennedy Presidential Library next door.

UMass Boston enrols approximately 15,400 students across its eleven colleges and schools, including the College of Liberal Arts, College of Management, College of Science and Mathematics, College of Nursing and Health Sciences, College of Education and Human Development, School for the Environment, and School for Global Inclusion and Social Development.

The university is classified as an R1 doctoral research institution and has been ranked among the top tier of national universities by U.S. News & World Report. Its location places students at the heart of Boston's research, technology, finance, biotech, and healthcare ecosystem, with direct subway access via the JFK/UMass MBTA station.

UMass Boston is one of the most diverse public research universities in the United States — students come from 140+ countries and speak 90+ languages, making it a natural home for international students seeking an affordable American degree in a global city.

В UMass Boston учится около 15 400 студентов на 11 колледжах и школах, включая College of Liberal Arts, College of Management, College of Science and Mathematics, College of Nursing and Health Sciences, College of Education and Human Development, School for the Environment и School for Global Inclusion and Social Development.

Университет имеет статус R1 doctoral research и входит в top tier национальных университетов по версии U.S. News & World Report. Локация даёт студентам прямой доступ к research, tech, finance, biotech и healthcare экосистеме Бостона — станция MBTA JFK/UMass у самого кампуса.

UMass Boston — один из самых diverse public research университетов США: студенты из 140+ стран говорят на 90+ языках. Естественный выбор для международных студентов, которым нужен доступный американский диплом в глобальном городе.
